notes.subject: החפץ אחפץ
notes.rationale: Infinitive absolute doubling of 'desire' — 'do I desire (at all) to desire' — rendered 'Bilong wanem, mi laikim'.

notes.subject: הלוא
notes.rationalale: Rhetorical negative question 'is it not?' rendered as emphatic 'A, no olsem'.
notes.rationale: Rhetorical negative question 'is it not?' rendered as emphatic 'A, no olsem'.

notes.subject: to Israel
notes.rationale: Rhetorical question addressed to the exiles challenging their complaint about Yahwe's justice.

translation: Bilong wanem, mi laikim long man nogut i dai? tok bilong Adonai Yahwe. A, no olsem — long em i go bek long ol rot bilong en, na em i stap orait.
